descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S19 「Save & Extract 和医院查房前任务收集的时间：AI 调用时间 vs 总时间，记录模型」 Save & Extract and Hospital pre-round harvest time: AI call time vs total, model recorded

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Timing: each Save & Extract run and each Hospital pre-round task harvest logs its AI call time separately from the total; any run over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause is reviewed (target, …（UAT 3.5）
  • U12 Each run records which AI ran each step: the model for task extraction (parsing.extractTasks) and for the Hospital pre-round processing, and whether the backup model was used（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.1）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The S04 + S05 fixtures, including the H-01…H-05 pre-round notes

When Run each fixture's Save & Extract call once more, and each Hospital fixture's pre-round processing (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes and the post-note parsing.extractTasks harvest), timing each call and reading its aiCallLog row right after it

Then Each call answers; providerMs and durationMs logged separately with the model id and any fallback, for both steps

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：maxMs 30000 per call, flagged for review, not Fail (3.5, Q9); a row without providerMs is a finding (3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). The Hospital harvest is the background step behind UAT step 1, so its time is what the physician waits for the three tasks

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-other（AI 输出检查）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-other。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：aicheck-other。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S19

Save & Extract and Hospital pre-round harvest time: AI call time vs total, model recorded

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane aicheck-other：aicheck-other/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（aicheck-other/plan.json，automatable: partly）：extract-ai runner timing mode over the TC-22 S04+S05 fixtures: Hospital H-01..H-05 = parsePreRoundNotes (client args from usePreRoundProcess.ts) + pre-round extractTasks harvest (variant omitted, 1,200 cut, openTasks []) + Save & Extract extractTasks 'encounter' with extractMedicationEvents in parallel (as the client does); Nursing Home N-01..N-05 = Save & Extract. Each call timed, its own diagnostics row read right after (matched by _creationTime): model, fellBackFrom, durationMs, providerMs. maxMs 30000 flags only; a row without providerMs is a finding. — Call/AI time is automated; the tap-to-message time the physician feels needs per-action timestamps in a browser run (TC-03 S13 style), not covered here.

Detail:

S04+S05 fixtures, 25 calls: every call answered, every aiCallLog row has model + durationMs + providerMs, all Haiku, 0 fallbacks, 0 over 30 s. Medians: parsePreRoundNotes 5.1 s (max 5.9), pre-round extractTasks harvest 2.7 s, Save & Extract extractTasks 3.2 s (max 6.7), extractMedicationEvents 3.4 s (parallel with it). The tap-to-message time a physician feels needs browser timestamps (not covered). Info for the S04/S05 owners, not this verdict: on local, H-01 (the UAT wording verbatim) pre-round made only 2 tasks ('Follow up BMP', 'PT evaluation' - 'Recheck weight in two weeks' was not harvested), Save & Extract then closed PT but not BMP and added no diet task; H-04 also lost the weight task; N-01 closed BMP and PT but added no diet task.

证据：附了 1 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (extract-ai + preround-ai, not built): it repeats and times direct parsing.extractTasks / parsing.parsePreRoundNotes calls with the client's arguments; on dev the runner calls no action (runner-contract §10.2), so it runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
